name: Cumulative revenue share of the top 20% of customers.
python_code:
# Calculate total revenue per customer
df_valid = df.dropna(subset=['Customer ID']).copy()
df_valid['Revenue'] = df_valid['Quantity'] * df_valid['Price']

# Aggregate revenue by customer
customer_revenue = df_valid.groupby('Customer ID')['Revenue'].sum().reset_index()
customer_revenue.columns = ['Customer ID', 'TotalRevenue']

# Sort customers by revenue descending
customer_revenue = customer_revenue.sort_values('TotalRevenue', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

# Calculate total revenue across all customers
total_revenue = customer_revenue['TotalRevenue'].sum()

# Calculate cumulative revenue share
customer_revenue['CumulativeRevenue'] = customer_revenue['TotalRevenue'].cumsum()
customer_revenue['CumulativeShare'] = customer_revenue['CumulativeRevenue'] / total_revenue

# Determine the top 20% of customers (by count)
num_customers = len(customer_revenue)
top_20_percent_count = int(num_customers * 0.2)
top_20_percent_customers = customer_revenue.head(top_20_percent_count)

# Get the cumulative revenue share of the top 20% of customers
result = top_20_percent_customers['CumulativeShare'].iloc[-1] if len(top_20_percent_customers) > 0 else 0.0
